text: Be careful. Portland is on fire. Our president says so. The rival gangs fighting. The clouds of tear gas all around us. Be careful. But actually, this isn't a war zone, whatever Trump says. It is perfectly peaceful. Legacy Media doesn't have any reporters filming the riots, and that's how the chief of police likes it. What bothers him are the journalists who are fair and balanced.
